title: CANFAR · Communities & Projects
description: Attribution of platform usage to communities and projects. canfar.net/community is the Kueue ClusterQueue / fair-share dimension and canfar.net/project the LocalQueue dimension, per CADC-15910. Both default to `default` when a session supplies none, so the Kueue queue labels are shown alongside as the working segmentation until launch-time attribution is populated.

list.name: datasource
list.label: Data source
list.description: Mimir. Prometheus remains selectable as a fallback.

list.name: community
list.label: Community
list.description: CANFAR `canfar.net/community` pod label. Kueue ClusterQueue / fair-share grouping dimension. Defaults to `default` when a session supplies none.

list.name: project
list.label: Project
list.description: CANFAR `canfar.net/project` pod label. Kueue LocalQueue dimension. Defaults to `default` when a session supplies none.

list.name: flavor
list.label: Flavor
list.description: `fixed` when the memory request equals the limit, otherwise `flexible`.

list.name: accelerator
list.label: Accelerator
list.description: `gpu` when the session requested GPUs, otherwise `none`. Exact GPU count comes from the nvidia.com/gpu resource request, not from this label.

panels.title: Communities
panels.description: Distinct canfar.net/community values on running sessions. Sessions that supply no value are labelled `default`, per the Skaha label contract — a large `default` bucket means attribution is not being set at launch, not that the dimension is unused.

panels.title: Projects
panels.description: Distinct canfar.net/project values on running sessions. Sessions that supply no value are labelled `default`, per the Skaha label contract — a large `default` bucket means attribution is not being set at launch, not that the dimension is unused.
